question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 19 days and B can do the same job in 16 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 5 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(19, 16, 5) = 19 × 16 × 5 = 1520 units

Efficiency of A = 1520 ÷ 19 = 80, Efficiency of B = 1520 ÷ 16 = 95

Combined Efficiency (A + B + C) = 1520 ÷ 5 = 304

Efficiency of C = 304 − (80 + 95) = 304 − 175 = 129 units/day

Time required for C = 1520 ÷ 129 = 11¹⁰¹/₁₂₉ days

**∴ The correct answer is 11¹⁰¹/₁₂₉ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 19 days

Time taken by B = 16 days

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 5 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of all individual days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 80 + 95 = 175 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = (Efficiency of A + B + C) − (Efficiency of A + B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 304 − 175 = 129 units/day

⇒ Time taken by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 1520 ÷ 129

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 11¹⁰¹/₁₂₉ days

**∴ The correct answer is 11¹⁰¹/₁₂₉ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Inlet pipes have positive efficiency while outlet pipes (leaks) have negative efficiency. Total capacity = LCM of individual times.

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If they work for the exact same duration, wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their daily efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

Find the total work done in a complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and multiply by the maximum possible integer before the remaining work is done individually.
